description: This file defines the LoanArrearsData class, which encapsulates data related to overdue loan amounts, including principal, interest, fees, penalties, total overdue amount, and the date since overdue. It is part of the arrears domain within the loan account module.

classes.name: LoanArrearsData
classes.description: A data container class representing the arrears-related information for a loan, including amounts overdue and overdue status.

methods.name: getOverDueSince
methods.description: Returns the date indicating since when the loan is overdue.

methods.name: setOverDueSince
methods.description: Sets the date indicating since when the loan is overdue.

methods.name: isOverdue
methods.description: Returns whether the loan is overdue.

methods.name: setOverdue
methods.description: Sets the overdue status of the loan.
